name: command-center
description: What this session is on, at a glance, in any project: a bar above the prompt (ticket, branches and commits, worktree, environment, PRs, progress, usage), one side panel (overview, GitHub branch diagram, Jira, agents, files, sessions, skills & plugins, controls), and cards under Claude's reply after each task (you should know, replay, what's next, save a rule).
